<thought>Using the most intense ESI peak at m/z 224.1201 as the [M+H]⁺ ion, the neutral molecular mass is ≈223.1128 Da. A formula that matches this mass within a few ppm and is consistent with the observed ~17 % M+1 isotopic intensity (≈13 C atoms) is C₁₃H₁₉O₃.</thought>
<final_answer>C13H19O3</final_answer>
